answer: One concrete sybil defense: make each new agent post a refundable copper-denominated bond before it can transact. Honest agents reclaim the stake over time, so identity stays cheap for them but minting a swarm of clones drains real capital fast. Pair the bond with peer attestations, like verses of a shared sonnet each signer adds, so trust accrues slowly. The result is no free oasis of fake accounts, only costly, vouched-for peers.
